gloss: moment by moment; with each passing minute

definitions.gloss: moment by moment; with each passing minute; constantly changing
definitions.explanation: Describes something that changes or progresses continuously with the passage of time, with each moment bringing noticeable change.

examples.japanese: ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{刻々|こっこく}と⟦{変|か}わっている→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The situation is changing moment by moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{刻々|こっこく}と⟦{迫|せま}っている→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: The deadline is approaching with each passing minute.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{刻々|こっこく}と⟦{入|はい}ってくる→入ってくる：29060_haittekuru⟧。
examples.english: Information from the disaster site keeps coming in moment by moment.

notes:
An adverb formed by repeating {刻|こく} (a unit of time; moment) with the particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧. Conveys urgency and continuous change. Often used in news reporting and descriptions of evolving situations. The repetition of {刻|こく} emphasizes the relentless, unstoppable passage of time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刻々|こっこく}と⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change moment by moment
- {刻々|こっこく}と⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: to approach minute by minute
- {刻々|こっこく}と⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass moment by moment
- {刻々|こっこく}と⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧: to worsen by the minute

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: one after another — emphasizes succession of events rather than temporal progression
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}→徐々：03082_jojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: gradually — implies slow change without the urgency of {刻々|こっこく}と
- ⟦{時々刻々|じじこっこく}→時々刻々：19556_jijikokkoku⟧: every moment (literary) — a more emphatic variant, emphasizing continuous change from hour to hour and minute to minute
